text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer! Let's make
this one a
good one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin starts off the new year by
coming directly to my office and
greeting me heartily.
However, I can't
help but wonder...
choice_data_list: Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna start train'n right away!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
After all, now that I'm in my classic
year...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's fin'lly time for me t'take on the
Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I bet there'll be tons more dazzl'n racers
there
than at the Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I wanna win, I'm gonna hafta work my
socks off!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So come on! Let's hurry and get train'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's great to see Yukino Bijin so fired
up, but she's
always pushing herself so hard.
I'd rather she put her feet up and relax
during New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you think? Well, in that case...
should I take
the day off?
choice_data_list: You worked hard all year, so there...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What do folks usually get up to on
days off,
anyway?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was just dead set on train'n today, so I
hadn't
thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We already cooked up some traditional
New
Year's food back at the dorm...
What else is there
t'do on New Year's?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'd hang out with Mifuyu, take care of
my li'l
sister, and... just laze around, I
s'pose.
choice_data_list: What did you do back home?
What did you do back home?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I did a lotta lay'n 'round. It's just
impossible
t'escape a nice and toasty
kotatsu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But now that I'm in the big city, I can't
just waste
all m'time under a kotatsu!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm... There's gotta be someth'n I can
do...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: By golly! You're right!
choice_data_list: Play to our hearts' content with e...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I arrived at Tracen, other
students've been tell'n me about all the
activities 'round here,
and I've been
itch'n to try 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did y'know there's an obstacle course
nearby?
Let's check't out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
See? Doesn't this place look neat? Let's
go and—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YUUUKIIIII!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow! What a crazy coincidence! Happy
New
Year!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Guess what, Trainer? Tickezo here's the
one who
told me 'bout this place!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Hi, I'm Winning Ticket! I
love running
and my dream is to win the
Derby! Nice to meet
ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are you here t'get some exercise too?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep! I was getting real restless from all
the loafing
around I was doing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm gonna run in the Derby this
year! How
am I supposed to stay still,
knowing that?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna start training today but my
roommate
told me to take it easy 'cause
I was out training
yesterday till curfew.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Zounds! That sounds just like what
happened to
me! I was plann'n on train'n
today too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wow, really? Oh, that's right! You're
gonna try
for the Triple Tiara this year,
right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's both realize our dreams this year!
Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! Since we're here, wanna hang
out
together?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Does a bird have wings? I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Nice! Let's go climb that mountain, then!
C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that looks like a real gas! Trainer,
you're
com'n too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, I end up joining them
for some recreational exercise. I'm
definitely nowhere near
as tough as they
are, however...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right there, Trainer? You're
look'n
awful wobbly.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Want me to carry you back? You look
light
enough!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can help too! Tag me in whenever,
Tickezo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having two Umamusume take turns
ferrying me
back home is certainly a
lively start to the new
year.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm, I see...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's important t'stop and smell the roses

sometimes, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My roomie Cafe told me about this
spiffy cafe a
while back! I bet we can
have a real swell time
there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well? What do y'think? Pretty snazzy
atmosphere, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I figured you gotta act all
grown-up in these kinda
places.
choice_data_list: Yeah... But why are you whispering?
Yeah... But why are you whispering?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You needn't worry about that. This
cafe has no
such rules.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hello, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hey, roomie! Long time, no see.
What's it
been? Since this morn'n?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I'm glad to see you've taken
a liking
to this cafe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I sure have! The parfait you recommended was so good, I just had t'have my trainer try it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They serve other delicious desserts as
well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowie, really?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For example, their pudding is made using
carefully selected ingredients.
They only sell a
limited amount each day
though.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That said... business has been a bit
slower than
usual today, so there should
still be some left.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oooh! I looove pudd'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll be off, then.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're leav'n already?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was just think'n it'd be awful nice if
you
stayed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I didn't want to intrude on your day out
with your
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nonsense! The more the merrier!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well... If you insist.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Here, sit next to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us usher in the new
year
leisurely.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wowzers! That's a spiffy idea if I've ever
heard
one!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There was this article in a 'zine City
gave me that talked about the best ways
t'spend a day off, so I
clipped it out for
my scrapbook!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait right here! I'll go get't!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly, things sure are diff'rent in the
city. They've
even got stores open on
New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City comes out here all the time t'buy
makeup. I
wanna try t'find something
cute for myself too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey. Wasn't expecting to run into
you here,
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look who's out and about. HNY,
girlie!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: HN... Oh! Happy New Year t'you too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. What brings you out
here?
Shopping?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Checking out the new beauty trends already? You're fast, girl. We're just here for some ramen. No better way to kill time than with food, amirite?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought I said I don't want ramen...
Ugh,
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That line of products over there is pretty
good quality for the price, by the way.
You should go
take a look if you're
interested.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're here for makeup, right? I thought
I'd give
you some of my
recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Awww. Well, aren't you sweet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, though. You never treat me
like that!
This is like top ten bestie
betrayal territory!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Didn't I give you a
free
sample?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I'm not talking about! I'm
talking
about your attitude! Show me
some love!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh, please.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Wow! Real city gals are so full of
energy even
on New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You learn something new ev'ry day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Yukino Bijin and I have a fun
New
Year's Day.
